gloss: seasonal feature; thing associated with a season

definitions.gloss: seasonal feature; thing associated with a season
definitions.explanation: something characteristic of or strongly associated with a particular season or time of year

examples.japanese: {花火|はなび}は{夏|なつ}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}だ。
examples.english: Fireworks are a quintessential part of summer.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|こうよう}は{秋|あき}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}だ。
examples.english: Autumn foliage is characteristic of fall.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}の{風物詩|ふうぶつし}といえば、{紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん}だ。
examples.english: Speaking of year-end traditions, it's the Kōhaku singing contest.

notes:
JAPANESE SEASONAL CULTURE:
{風物詩|ふうぶつし} reflects Japan's strong awareness of seasons and their associated customs.

EXAMPLES BY SEASON:

{春|はる} (Spring):
- {花見|はなみ} - cherry blossom viewing
- {入学式|にゅうがくしき} - school entrance ceremonies
- {鯉|こい}のぼり - carp streamers (Children's Day)

{夏|なつ} (Summer):
- {花火|はなび} - fireworks
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り - Bon dancing
- {風鈴|ふうりん} - wind chimes
- {蝉|せみ}の{声|こえ} - cicada sounds
- {甲子園|こうしえん} - high school baseball tournament

{秋|あき} (Autumn):
- {紅葉|こうよう} - autumn foliage
- {運動会|うんどうかい} - sports day
- {月見|つきみ} - moon viewing

{冬|ふゆ} (Winter):
- {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん} - New Year's Eve singing contest
- {除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね} - temple bell on New Year's Eve
- {初詣|はつもうで} - first shrine visit of the year
